==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|
*Ask [[Duke Horacio]] in Lumbridge Castle for a quest and he'll give you an [[air talisman]]. {{Chat option|1 Have you any quests for me?|1 Yes.}}
*Talk to [[Archmage Sedridor]] in the [[Wizards' Tower]] basement and give him the [[air talisman]]. {{Chat option|1 Okay, here you are.|2 Actually, I'm not interested.|1 Yes, certainly.}}
*Talk to [[Aubury]] south of [[Varrock east bank]] in the [[Varrock rune shop]] and give him the [[research package]]. {{Chat option|1 I've been sent here with a package for you.}}
*Take the [[Research notes (Rune Mysteries)|research notes]] back to Sedridor.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
